quote: For me, the comparison will always be there; GTA V has much more irreverence, you could be whatever you wanted whereas in this case it's more politically correct. I'd prefer less beautiful graphics. But the freedom that GTA V gave us will unfortunately not return; bugs can be fixed, stories can be improved, but the essence, once lost, never returns.
